SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 2554/26
S.2, Special Br.
Date 22 / 8 / 33
August 22 - 1933

Subject (in full) Meeting of communist suspects held in Western Chapei.

Made by D.I.Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [Signature]

Agent A-4123 reports that five communist adherents of
the Western District held a meeting under one Siao Yang (小杨)
on a piece of vacant ground near the junction of Robison and
Kiaochow Roads, O.O.L., between 7 and 8 p.m. August 21, 1933
and discussed the following :-
(1) That cells each consisting of five persons be organized
in various industrial concerns in the Western District
and that each cell hold two meetings weekly.
(2) That the abolition of bonuses and the employment of casual
workers be opposed.
(3) That the people be urged to support the Barbusse Mission
and that struggles be commenced in various industrial
concerns.
(4) That a Women's Department be organized to undertake
propaganda among female workers.
The description of Siao Yang is as follows:-
Age about 27, native of Hunan, height 5'5", fair
complexion, long face, usually dresses in a blue cloth
worker's suit. He is reported to be the Clerk of the
Labour Department of the Shanghai Western Special District
Committee of the Chinese Communist Party.
Particulars of this individual have been recorded.

(印：FILED / [Signature] / O.C./C.S.B)

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.
